items.caption: A modern redraw of 票 in Shuowen seal-script style. The Shuowen form is reported as 𤐫, glossed “fire flying”; in later clerical writing, its lower 火 was written 示. This image illustrates the seal-style form, not an artifact or a separate depiction of 𤐫.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style glyph centered on a white square.
items.selection_reason: It provides a useful visual example of the Shuowen seal-style form and its place in the account of 票. The image is a modern redraw, and the upper element’s referent remains unidentified.
